title: Prenatal androgens and female-advantaged cognition: A systematic review and Bayesian meta-analysis in congenital adrenal hyperplasia
title_zh: 产前雄激素与女性优势认知：先天性肾上腺皮质增生的系统综述与贝叶斯荟萃分析
abstract: Females with Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (CAH) are exposed to elevated levels of androgens during the prenatal period, offering insights into the effects of early hormonal influences on brain and cognition. Although spatial abilities, which typically favor males, have received considerable attention in the context of CAH, this is the first review to systematically examine cognitive domains that generally show a female advantage. By meta-analyzing 43 effect sizes from 11 studies, we assessed whether elevated prenatal androgens are associated with shifts toward male-typical performance across four such domains. Results offer partial support for an androgenic influence, with the strongest evidence observed in verbal fluency, where females with CAH performed worse than controls (μˆ = - 0.34), in contrast to their comparable or slightly enhanced performance on male-favoring spatial tasks (μˆ = 0.19). Weaker support emerged for perceptual speed (μˆ = - 0.17). In addition, two effect sizes suggested reduced emotion recognition, although the magnitude of these effects differed substantially (g = -0.11 and g = -1.44). Findings for episodic memory were inconclusive, characterized by substantial heterogeneity and mixed results. Overall, while the modest number of studies and the small magnitude of expected effects limit reliability and generalizability, these results contribute to a growing body of evidence suggesting that prenatal androgens shape sex-typical cognitive and behavioral development, potentially masculinizing patterns of cognition, behavior, and interests in females with CAH.
abstract_zh: 先天性肾上腺皮质增生（CAH）女性在产前期暴露于升高的雄激素水平，为早期激素影响大脑与认知的作用提供了洞见。虽然空间能力（通常偏向男性）在CAH背景下已受到相当关注，但本综述首次系统评估了通常显示女性优势的认知领域。通过对11项研究中43个效应量进行荟萃分析，我们评估了产前雄激素升高是否与四个此类领域的男性化表现转变相关。结果部分支持雄激素影响，最强证据出现在言语流畅性上，CAH女性的表现低于对照组（μˆ = -0.34），与其在偏向男性的空间任务中表现相当或略优（μˆ = 0.19）形成对比。感知速度的支持较弱（μˆ = -0.17）。此外，两个效应量提示情绪识别下降，尽管效应大小差异显著（g = -0.11 与 g = -1.44）。情节记忆的结果不确定，表现出显著异质性和混合结果。总体而言，尽管研究数量有限且预期效应幅度小，限制了可靠性和可推广性，但这些结果为日益增长的证据贡献了一份，表明产前雄激素塑造性别典型的认知与行为发展，可能使CAH女性的认知、行为和兴趣趋向男性化。
